QuestInfo.name: Pixies' Cloud Pieces
QuestInfo.1: The girl in #p2032001#'s house said that Spiruna had discovered the cause of Orbis's sinking. The Pixies have been absorbing the magic from the enchanted clouds that hold it afloat. Now the #o3230200#, #o4230106#, and #o5120000# monsters have taken #b25 #t4031309##k items needed for maintenance!\n
QuestInfo.2: Just the way the mysterious girl at #p2032001#'s house requested, I gathered up 25 #t4031309#s from the Pixie's and gave them to her.
QuestInfo.0: Talk to  the girl you met at #p2032001#'s house again.

0.0: Spiruna told me everything she knew when she came out of her trance! All of this is happening because of those bratty Pixies! \r\n#L0##bPixies?#l\n#k
0.1: Yes, the reason why Orbis is floating on air is because of these magical clouds. Lately, however, the Pixies have begun to absorb the magic power from the clouds, just to fill up their stamina, and the clouds will surely weaken, all the way to the point where Orbis may be in danger of crashing down.\r\n#L0# #bAhhh, that's what it meant by that!#k
0.2: We need to get the #t04031309#s from the pixies so we can start the maintenance check with the clouds.

yes.0:
We need Cloud Pieces to fix up the clouds that hold Orbis up, but the Pixies have been taking them! Star Pixies, Lunar Pixies, Luster Pixies... you name it! Please get #b25 #t4031309##k items back for us! 
I bet those greedy Luster Pixies took most of them...

no.0: So you don't mind Orbis slowly sinking down until it crashes and burns?

1.0: You brought #t4031309#! Can I see this? Wow... the #t4031309# still contains some magic power, so I should be careful with it. Orbis will never go down again after using these clouds for the maintenance check. Thank you so much.

item.0: We need #b25 #t4031309##k items to get construction back on track! I think, I don't really know much about construction.
